200.description: All current capability offers (empty array when none).

items.description: What this context would advertise to the network it can ship for one (SKU, site) (ADR 0001 §8).

siteId.description: The fulfillment site the offer is for.

advertisedQuantity.description: The quantity we would advertise: `min(physicalAvailable, throughputFeasibleBefore(nextCutoff))`.

basis.description: Which rule produced `advertisedQuantity`. `PHYSICAL` means physical stock on hand was the binding constraint (or throughput was unknown). `THROUGHPUT_CONSTRAINED` means the eligible paths' remaining capacity before the next cutoff some path can still make (ADR 0031) was.

computedAt.description: When the recompute loop last computed this offer.

items.title: CapabilityOffer

500.description: An RFC 7807 problem document. A NUL character (U+0000) is never valid input (PostgreSQL text cannot hold it): in the request path it is a 404 `resource-not-found`, in a query parameter a 400 `invalid-request`, and in a request body a 400 `malformed-request-body`.
